source: Hamlet: Whether it's nobler to try and suffer through the pain... Hamlet: Or turn our backs to all of it and welcome the inevitable embrace of death a little earlier. Hamlet: To die—to sleep no more—And by sleeping, I mean to end the heartache, the thousand little pains I have to bear. Hamlet: I wish I could. Just die—sleep, sleep, and maybe dream... that would be it. Who knows what I might dream of in death? Hamlet: What do you think... Ophelia?
target: 哈姆雷特: 究竟是努力熬过痛苦更为高尚…… 哈姆雷特: 还是背弃这一切，早一些迎接那终将到来的死亡之拥。 哈姆雷特: 死去——不过是睡去，如此而已。而我说的睡眠，是让心痛终结，让我必须承受的千般细碎痛楚终结。 哈姆雷特: 真希望我能做到。就这样死去——睡去，睡去，也许做个梦……就这么结束。谁知道死后我会梦见什么？ 哈姆雷特: 你觉得呢……奥菲莉娅？
